AccountId.title: AccountId
AccountId.description: Salesforce ID of the Account record to update. Must be a valid 15 or 18-character Salesforce ID.

FieldApiName.title: FieldApiName
FieldApiName.description: API name of the Account field to update. Permitted values: Industry, Type, Phone, Website, Description, NumberOfEmployees. Any other value will be rejected by the action.

NewValue.title: NewValue
NewValue.description: New value to set for the specified field, passed as a string. For NumberOfEmployees, must be a whole number string.
